workflow: Generate a complete natural underwater scene, then apply style-transfer to that image, preserving its environment and perspective.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a complete underwater scene image, landscape 4:3, intended as the photographic foundation for a later stylised FinFolk illustration.
Primary request: create a believable single underwater camera view of an adult freediver ascending from a coastal reef toward sunlight at the water surface. The scene should feel like a real underwater photograph with a coherent environment, continuous geology, perspective, atmospheric depth and underwater illumination.
Scene/backdrop: a beautiful temperate Australian coastal reef, rugged submerged rock walls and a natural reef arch toward the lower left/middle distance, tall kelp growing out of the rocks on both sides, a continuous rocky seabed that recedes into blue water. Small fish inhabit the kelp and a distant small school crosses the middle distance naturally.
Subject: one freediver at middle distance, slightly right of centre, ascending diagonally toward the sunlit upper right, arms relaxed along the sides, wearing a simple dark wetsuit, low volume diving mask and two long freediving fins. Calm natural body posture, correct anatomy, no tanks or bubbles. Diver is about one third of the frame height and belongs in the water rather than filling the frame.
Composition/framing: wide immersive underwater landscape viewed from below and a little behind the diver, foreground kelp and dark reef edges frame a luminous open-water corridor. The eye follows the rocks and diver upward toward the surface. Seafloor, rocks, plants and fish occupy different natural distances, never arranged as separate icons. Clear but subtle natural arch, not an isolated bridge shape. Show the distant refracted surface and oblique shafts of sunlight.
Lighting/mood: serene cinematic underwater photograph, convincing light scattering, aquatic haze, soft caustics on rocks, rich dark foreground and luminous distance, excellent natural detail.
Color palette: natural deep marine blue, teal water, bronze-green kelp and neutral stone.
Text: none. No captions, logos, watermark, border, pattern wallpaper, graphic cutouts, collage, vector art, graphic-design layout or human interface. Fully opaque finished image.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a finished single illustrated underwater scene for FinFolk, landscape 4:3, full bleed opaque raster artwork.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and scene geometry reference: a photograph-like underwater kelp-reef scene with a freediver ascending. Input image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for its navy, warm ivory and dusty rose inks, sophisticated engraved marine drawing, curling organic shapes, bold positive/negative space and luxury textile/screenprint sensibility.
Primary request: reinterpret the entire underwater scene in image 1 as a richly stylised 1960s/70s marine woodcut / limited-ink screenprint illustration. Preserve the photographed viewpoint, continuous reef landscape, left rock arch, kelp rooting in foreground and receding into the distance, sunlit open-water corridor, fish at different distances and the position, scale and ascending pose of the main diver. Keep exactly one human diver. The result must read immediately as a single immersive underwater landscape with believable spatial relationships, viewed from within the water.
Rendering: turn the main diver into one elegant uninterrupted deep-navy silhouette with mask and two long freediving fins, relaxed arms, facing the light. Draw the surrounding landscape as a unified illustration with large sculptural navy reef masses and finely engraved ivory detail following actual rock contours and kelp leaves. Let water, light shafts and refracted surface become sweeping organic ivory-and-navy bands with delicate curving current lines and selective dusty-rose accents. Shape the subtle decorative patterns to the perspective, caustics, reef and flowing water; they must belong to the scene. Retain atmospheric depth by simplifying the far reef into paler shapes and using stronger dark foreground forms. The camera sees through the underwater environment toward the light, not down at a flat design board. Natural elegant kelp silhouettes, intricate reef detail, small recognisable fish, beautiful clear negative space around the diver.
Palette: midnight navy #172440 and warm ivory #f2e8d6 dominate, with restrained dusty rose #bc8190 details, matching image 2. No natural blue/green photographic colour remains. Flat ink areas, subtle engraved linework and very fine paper/ink texture, not photorealism and not merely a colour filter.
Composition invariants: preserve image 1's whole-frame composition and natural physical scene, same prominent reef arch on the left and main diver to the right of centre rising toward the upper-right surface light. Do not copy image 2's repeating octopuses or use it as a background tile. Do not introduce oversized animals or other people. No isolated icons, assembled clip-art, collage, separate cutout layers on wallpaper, repeated tiled background, disconnected floating rocks, UI, text, captions, logo, frame or watermark. Deliver the illustration only.
